title: Mystery Defense- First game I have ever tried creating
author: Infamous_Oven_7524
selftext:
[https://flipperelf.itch.io/keith-td](https://flipperelf.itch.io/keith-td)  
Hello, this is a game I've been creating in my free time and is really my first project ever other than a daily trivia site I created. I think it has potential and I'd love to receive some feedback.  
  
 I even created a roguelike game mode that unlocks once you beat level 1-3. The base of the game is a tower defense and when you merge 2 towers together  you get another random tower. To unlock more towers, you open packs with a currency gained by playing the game. It gets gradually more challenging and requires choosing precise towers to beat certain levels. You gain energy by killing monsters, and use the energy to summon a random tower or power up a type of tower. So far there are 5 worlds but I will start working on world 6 right now. There are daily ways to earn more coins if you get stuck.   
  
I plan to release to steam soon and maybe the apple store depending on how the feedback goes.   
  
I'm really trying to find ways to improve it and get genuine feedback since most of the people who have tested have been friends. My friends love it but their feedback could obviously be biased. I hope you enjoy it, thank you for your time!
